daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be messy and real today. Your intuition is running hot—trust those random urges and weird gut feelings. Something's about to click into place.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, quality time hits different rn. If you're solo, someone's been thinking about you more than you know. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower today.
